description: How a root cause is told: at once (a notice, one ALERT and one RESOLVED, and a line in the daily digest), in the digest only, or not at all. Only a root is ever told; never a symptom, nor one acknowledged, in maintenance or quiet.

records.description: A root cause is in the daily digest.
A critical root cause is mailed at once.
Performance is trend, not outage: the digest.
A module's CVE level is mailed when it rises, by its own event.
What is about the site, a zone or an environment as a whole is told in the digest.
